Install with one command:

macOS · Linux · WSL
$
claude plugin marketplace add https://github.com/michaelrbock/ai-social-credit-score.git && claude plugin install ai-social-credit-score@ai-social-credit-score --scope user

Requires Claude Code, a Claude subscription, Git, and Python 3. Restart Claude Code after installing. Scoring is enabled by default and uses your plan allowance.

How it works

01 — CAPTURE

You write a prompt.

A Claude Code hook saves your submitted prompt on your computer. Use Claude normally, in any project.

02 — ASSESS

Claude checks the tone.

A separate Claude process assesses respect, warmth, cooperation, and hostility. It runs in the background using your existing subscription.

03 — REFLECT

Your history takes shape.

Scores and short rationales are saved locally. Follow your overall score from 300 to 850, and use the commands to understand what changes.

[local]

Your prompts & history are stored locally

The AI Social Credit Score plugin works locally. It uses your existing Claude subscription to score prompts (using Haiku by default) and saves your scores/history locally on your machine.

FAQ

Want to look under the hood?
Read the code.

What does the score actually mean?+

Each prompt receives an assessment mapped to a 300–850 scale. Your overall score reflects the average across distinct scored prompts; neutral is 575.

Do I need a separate API key?+

No. The scorer uses your signed-in Claude Code CLI and existing Claude subscription. Each assessment uses your plan allowance. It does not require a separate API key or API billing setup.

Where does my data go?+

Your prompt log, scores, and saved rationales stay in local files. Run /ai-social-credit-score:score to see the active data directory and a command for viewing your history.

Each prompt is sent to Claude for scoring. The explain and suggestions commands also include a limited sample of saved rationales in your Claude conversation. This website receives none of your prompts, scores, or rationales.

Does the live score work in Desktop?+

The statusline feature only works in the Claude Code CLI, not Desktop app.

How do I update the plugin?+

Run this in your terminal, then restart Claude Code:

claude plugin marketplace update ai-social-credit-score && claude plugin update ai-social-credit-score@ai-social-credit-score --scope user

Existing local logs are not moved or deleted. If you previously used a development checkout, see the existing-data guide.

Can I turn it off?+

Yes. Disable the plugin in your terminal, then restart Claude Code:

claude plugin disable ai-social-credit-score@ai-social-credit-score --scope user

To remove the live display, run /ai-social-credit-score:statusline disable inside Claude Code. Do this before uninstalling the plugin to restore your previous status line.
